verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://maritime.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a product summary. Maritime also publishes agent-oriented docs: a CLI-specific llms.txt with instructions for agents, an AI-agents page with a paste-in prompt for Claude or Cursor, and runbook pages agents are meant to follow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs successfully, and markdown versions of the docs pages (docs.md returns 404).
